user.title: Connect EMHASS to your FoxESS inverter
user.description: The bridge writes through the FoxESS Cloud Open API integration (ha-foxess-openapi), which must already be set up for the inverter. Pick that inverter and the sensors EMHASS publishes.

data_description.device_id: The device created by the FoxESS Cloud Open API integration.
data_description.emhass_entity: Usually sensor.p_batt_forecast. Its battery_scheduled_power attribute is the plan.
data_description.emhass_grid_entity: Usually sensor.p_grid_forecast. Used to tell grid charging from PV surplus charging.

error.device_invalid: This device does not belong to the FoxESS Cloud Open API integration.

abort.foxess_openapi_missing: Install and set up the FoxESS Cloud Open API integration (ha-foxess-openapi) first.
abort.already_configured: A bridge for this inverter is already configured.

rate_limited.title: FoxESS API request limit exhausted
rate_limited.description: The FoxESS Cloud Open API allows 1440 requests per inverter and day and that quota is used up or down to the bridge's reserve. The bridge pauses its scheduler calls and resumes at {resume_at}. If this happens regularly, lengthen the polling intervals of the FoxESS Cloud Open API integration.

data_description.charge_threshold_w: A plan step counts as grid charging when EMHASS plans at least this much battery charging power and grid import.
data_description.min_window_minutes: Charge windows shorter than this are not written to the inverter.
data_description.max_groups: FoxESS accepts up to 8 groups. When the plan needs more, the windows with the least energy are dropped.
data_description.plan_max_age_hours: When the EMHASS plan is older than this, the bridge clears the schedule and the inverter returns to self-use.

apply_plan.name: Apply plan
apply_plan.description: Run the apply loop now instead of waiting for the next quarter hour.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: The bridge entry to act on. Leave empty for all.

clear_schedule.name: Clear schedule
clear_schedule.description: Disable the mode scheduler on the inverter and switch the bridge off so it stays disabled.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: The bridge entry to act on. Leave empty for all.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Write scheduler groups by hand, for experiments. Refused while the bridge is live, because the next apply run would overwrite them.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: The bridge entry to act on. Leave empty for all.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: Up to 8 groups with start, end (inclusive minute), work_mode (SelfUse, Feedin, Backup, ForceCharge, ForceDischarge), min_soc_on_grid, fd_soc, fd_pwr and max_soc.

enable.name: Enable scheduler
enable.description: Switch the mode scheduler on after writing the groups.
